🌟 text-to-cad | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the generation and manipulation of CAD and robot description files using natural language commands and AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • Agent skills for CAD, CAE, and CAM • Text-to-CAD model generation • Image-to-CAD model generation • STEP, STL, 3MF export for CAD • URDF and SDF generation for robotics
📖 Summary: The text-to-cad repository provides a Python library of agent skills designed to automate the creation, inspection, and manipulation of CAD, CAE, and CAM artifacts. It enables users to generate and modify CAD models, robot descriptions (URDF, SRDF), and simulation files (SDF) using natural language or image inputs.
